name: Dictionary App Builder
blurb: Dictionary App Builder helps you to build customized dictionary apps for Android and iOS smartphones and tablets.
description: Dictionary App Builder helps you to build customized dictionary apps for Android and iOS smartphones and tablets. You specify the lexicon data file to use, the app name, fonts, colors, the about box information, the audio, illustrations and the icons. Dictionary App Builder will package everything together and build the customized app for you. You can then install it on your phone, send it to others by Bluetooth, share it on microSD memory cards and publish it to app stores on the Internet.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
